content.en_US: Advanced processming machine, commonly used for increasing [[bedrock ore processing|Bedrock Ore Processing]] yields. Has two modes: One will electrolyze fluids, such as water into [[hydrogen|Liquid Hydrogen]] and [[oxygen|Liquid Oxygen]], and one that processes ore crystals using [[nitric acid|Nitric Acid]] into molten metals which can be cast. Necessary in the creation of [[deuterium|Deuterium]].
